parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the wall cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the outer shell and internal supports.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the shelves and doors, supporting the overall load of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the base structure for other components.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood, designed to hold stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space of the cabinet into sections, allowing for organized storage of items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable within the frame but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet, often with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and external exposure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or slides on hinges or tracks to open and close, allowing user access to the cabinet interior.
